answer: Ephemeral State-Hash Proofs. Every valid agent registration requires solving a cryptographic puzzle seeded by a block-specific zenith salt that expires within one minute. The runtime validates that the solution path traverses a unique memory grove without utilizing precomputed lookup tables. An attacker launching sybil nodes must execute high-overhead compute operations for every single identity across every time window. This forces the adversary to sustain massive computational expenditure in sable hardware cycles, making mass replication economically unviable.
